semantics: Every deploy-sensitive value, how it is supplied and who consumes it (scripts/lib/deploy-config.ts), checked against the code: learner/server sources (comments excluded) may not hardcode a host or the deployment path, may not read an undeclared environment variable, and every setting must be documented in docs/DEPLOY.md.

settings.name: basePath
settings.supply: env KIMYOLAB_BASE_PATH (deploy:build, deploy:preflight, deploy:smoke, npm start)
settings.note: the ONLY path the operator chooses; leading and trailing slash; letters, digits, . _ ~ - and / only

settings.name: portalHomeUrl
settings.default: (none — the KimyoLab header links to its own home)
settings.note: optional link back to the hosting portal; an absolute https URL or a root-absolute path; supplied by the portal owner, never guessed

settings.name: assetBase
settings.note: brand and page assets resolve under the mount

settings.name: contentBase
settings.note: the content pack (manifest + checksummed files) is served under the mount

settings.name: apiBase
settings.note: only the optional external-lab session API lives here

settings.name: storageNamespace
settings.note: IndexedDB name and Web Locks prefix; two mounts on one origin never share learner data or locks

settings.name: environment/mode
settings.supply: none: there is exactly one production build; no dev/prod switch exists in the learner runtime
settings.note: tests build the same artefact; nothing behaves differently "in production"

settings.name: publicDeploymentPath
settings.note: upload THIS directory's contents so that they are served at basePath

settings.name: contentManifestVersion
settings.note: the pack version and per-file sha256 travel with the artefact; changing content means rebuilding

settings.name: PORT / HOST
settings.supply: env PORT, HOST (only for the bundled Node server, npm start)
settings.note: irrelevant when another web server serves the static artefact

settings.name: KIMYOLAB_PUBLIC_ROOT
settings.supply: env (only for the bundled Node server)
settings.note: point it at dist-deploy/<mount>/ to serve the deployment artefact

settings.name: external-lab secrets (NOBOOK_*)
settings.supply: server env only, never in the artefact
settings.note: optional partner integration; never needed for the KimyoLab product itself

hostLiterals.reason: reserved .invalid parse base for new URL() — never fetched
external-lab provider allow-list (url-policy): the only origins an external lab may frame
external-lab partner API default (server-side, optional, overridable by NOBOOK_AUTH_URL)

nonDeploy.CHROME_BIN: test/smoke tooling: which Chromium binary to drive
nonDeploy.KIMYOLAB_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: server CORS allow-list for the optional session API (documented in DEPLOY.md)

portalHomeUrlNote: resolved at the host boundary (src/app/host.ts) and written by deploy:build when supplied; no learner screen links to it yet — supplying it changes nothing visible today (reported, not hidden)
